LOTTOFPRINTS.text: Visual identity (print and motion) for ECAL’s lottery game.

SYNTHETIC_ORGANIC.text: Synthetic Organic is a series of eight 3D sculptures, presented in a 20-page A3 booklet printed by inkjet.

SENS_UNIK.text: Unselected project. Proposal for a static and motion visual identity for the music group Sens Unik. The 3D imagery depicts the group’s hometown of Renens (1020 CH) through a dystopian lens inspired by comic book aesthetics, including the development of multiple logo variations.

LAMANT.text: Title design for musician Stéphane Capdenat-Christy's first single L'amant.

GRIME_INDEX.text: Grime Index is an interactive VJ-ing project that centralizes, visualizes, and allows users to navigate through iconic moments in grime music.

CamilleLeprinceWEB.text: Website designed and developed for photographer Camille Leprince.

StencilPoster.text: Stencil poster cut into wood. Typographic design in collaboration with Hugo Scholl and Brian Roettinger.

RLSH.text: Editorial work based on Vladislav Iouchkov’s 2017 thesis, “The Hero with a Thousand Graces”: A Socio-Criminological Examination of the Real Life Super Hero Phenomenon.

Relay.text: Typeface and type specimen developed under the supervision of Aurèle Sack.

COSMA.text:
Cosma is an in-progress display typeface rooted in the techno-futurist electronics of the late 70s refined into a modular system.
Cosma extends these models through three variable axes—Weight, Width, and Contrast.
